verdict.rationale: Rippling advertises multiple AI-driven insight features: AI-built reports/dashboards on labor cost trends (docs-5), natural-language headcount queries (docs-42/49), AI-driven benefits document review and instant employee answers (docs-20, docs-21). This shows real AI-generated insights/suggestions across HR, time, and benefits data, but all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no independent hands-on validation of depth or accuracy. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of AI insight quality, technical detail on underlying models, and broader coverage beyond these few product pages.
